blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Even air-conditioning would not be enough to fully El Niño-proof public school classrooms in the country—proper building insulation is a must. A Hawaii-based Filipino architect and a president of a university in Dumaguete City, which received the Department of Environment and Natural Resources award for sustainable and eco-friendly schools on Monday made this observation as he noted that most classrooms lack this key feature. Victor Vicente Sinco, president of Foundation University (FU), even noted that a lack of insulation could still be felt even with air-conditioning. “Even in an air-conditioned space, you can still feel the lack of […]...
